notes:
Patch 0.1.23

Ore rocks
- Copper, iron, gold, and skyiron no longer read as a colored crack web on dark stone.
- Ore sits in pockets, stains, and flecks on the rock face. Crack ore is dialed down.
- Distant rock copies use the same ore look as the close mesh.

Also since 0.1.22
- Selected hotbar item picture stays in the slot
- Joining a host no longer leaves you under the island
- Strike notice with Dispute this link
- Sun glare blinds when you look into it, clears when you look away
- Online menu: patch notes lower, Back spaced, rename no longer covers current name

This Apply ships matched Game data from a fresh build so the stone materials land. Close Manafall before Apply.
